rerank._comment: LLM constrained-rerank parameters. candidate_pool caps how many top-scored models are sent to the LLM. llm_weight blends the LLM ranking position score into the final score: final = rule_score*(1-llm_weight) + llm_position_score*llm_weight. The LLM may only reorder the provided candidate IDs (hallucinated IDs are discarded).

hybrid_retrieval._comment: Light mode uses factual sparse retrieval by default. The competition_dense Docker override enables required, offline, manifest-verified BGE-M3 at the frozen 0.50 weight.

score_blend._comment: Final score blend coefficients. total = base_total*base + graph_path_match*graph + field_compatibility*field. These three must sum to 1.0 for the score to stay on a 0-100 scale.
